kanjiTeachingPlan.title: strong; taut
kanjiTeachingPlan.titleEvidence: Frozen KANJIDIC2 strong; actual Digital Daijisen 勁: ぴんと張りつめて、つよい。力がつよい. Taut conveys the stretched-tight qualification, not an unrestricted new English verb.

onRow.gloss: vigorous style in art or prose
onRow.allocation: Actual 勁 character entry labels 音ケイ and lists 雄勁; full1839950 supplies written word/reading/POS. Actual 雄 character entry gives 音ユウ and its strength sense; this is not allocation from kana substrings alone.
onRow.usefulness: Bounded recognition of descriptive artistic/prose vocabulary, not an everyday frequency claim or an N1 vocabulary-list addition.

kunRow.disposition: Documented recognition only; preserve full source reading but do not offer it in quizzes.
kunRow.qualification: JMdict1236070 explicitly marks 勁い search-only. Describe the indexed spelling without recommending ordinary use, inventing a separate pronunciation, calling the documented reading invalid, or creating a duplicate support article.

kanjiTeachingPlan.origin: Explicit modern-shape mnemonic only: the 巠-shaped left part beside right-hand 力 can be imagined held taut or strong. Identify the shape as a memory aid, not historical derivation, verified phonetic component or an independent everyday word. Omit phonetic metadata/facts.
kanjiTeachingPlan.radicalDisposition: Canonical classical 力/no.19 is the visible right-hand component; do not replace it with an invented left-part radical.
kanjiTeachingPlan.nameUseDisposition: Grade9 is the source's name-use classification, not a personal-name lesson, frequency proof or reason to remove named-set membership.
kanjiTeachingPlan.optionalNotTaught: No need to add the other eight member families, martial-arts terms, 勁草, or personal names to Common words merely because the dictionary contains them.

Same right-hand 力, different left block; censuring/investigating wrongdoing is not strength/tautness.
Different left block and right-hand 刂 rather than 力; opening/dissection is not strength/tautness.

kanjiTeachingPlan.distractorPoolDisposition: All three exist, are N1-labelled and have different displayed labels from the target and one another. Existing direct exclusions do not forbid these pairs. This avoids dependence on absent easier-level distractors in the default N1 pool. Actual qualified production builder tests remain required.

directGuardReasons.evidence: Exact ordinary strong sense in both complete character records; full1236070 also retains 勁い as a search-only spelling of つよい. Do not use the lexical alias as a frequency or free-spelling rule.
Raw 剛 strength/sturdy, actual article strength/unyielding and inspected 剛健 family overlap ordinary strength; this is not a claim that rigidity is every use of 勁.
Raw 力 power/strength/strong and actual 勁 definition 力がつよい make power defensible, despite noun/adjective differences in English.
Actual 勁 forceful strength versus complete 勢 forces/energy/military strength and article vigor. Guard the force/strength overlap, not every temporal-momentum use.

nearbyNoNewGuardEstablished.reason: Actual labels hard/stiff and firm/harden concern hardness or becoming firm. Full1257110 includes strong among many senses of かたい, but that does not alone establish that either character label is an ordinary answer for 勁's taut strength. No automatic exclusion from a single English gloss; not selected as wrong choices.

Vitality/refinement, courage, lasting duration, enduring/surpassing and venturing into danger are related ideas, not demonstrated alternative answers for strong/taut. Complete actual bodies inspected; no transitive guard or claim of universal disjointness.
Weakness, lightness, labor and effort are not ordinary strength/tautness labels. Effort can produce strength without being the same meaning.

supportTeachingPlan.title: vigorous style (art; prose)
supportTeachingPlan.wordLevel: Not established; omit jlpt and do not infer it from the N1 characters.
supportTeachingPlan.senses: Noun/adjectival-noun vigor or power, characteristically of calligraphy, painting, poetry or prose. Teach this established descriptive use without claiming the source defines an absolute art-only boundary.

example.evidence: Actual Digital Daijisen 雄勁 short example, with its headword expanded at the dash. Full1487850 verifies 筆跡ひっせき and handwriting sense; ふであと and rare alternate spellings remain source evidence, not assigned to this example.
example.scope: Attested short noun phrase, not an invented attestation or a copied extended passage. Explain な explicitly.

supportTeachingPlan.grammar: 雄勁な + noun; polite predicate 雄勁です. Not an i-adjective; do not invent 雄勁い or assume a する verb from noun status.
supportTeachingPlan.componentTeaching: ユウ + ケイ. 雄 evokes imposing strength here and 勁 strength; the related meaning reinforces forceful expression. This is a meaning aid, not a historical reconstruction or an assertion that the word means male handwriting.
supportTeachingPlan.missingComponent: 雄 has no current card; include it in full word metadata, leave its component plain with reading where helpful, and do not introduce an out-of-batch 雄 card or broken link.
supportTeachingPlan.comparisons: 力強いちからづよい is a broader i-adjective for power/vigor and can also mean reassuring; 強いつよい is the ordinary broad adjective strong. Do not make 雄勁 a general replacement for either or give it the reassurance sense. Weak/feeble expression is a contextual contrast, not a universal one-word antonym.
